Underfoot stabilisers: Elastomeric Underfoot Stabilizers — vibration absorption, high speed stability, reduced foot fatigue [1][MERCHANT] 43. Tip/tail damping: Harmonic Nose/Tail Dampers — reduces vibrations for smooth and stable ride at speed and hard landings [1][27] 44.
